title: Install packages from a saved list
summary: Reinstall packages listed in a text file, skipping those that are already installed. This is useful for setting up a new system with the same software.
prerequisites: You have a file named pkglist.txt containing package names.

steps.explain: Install packages from pkglist.txt, but only if they are not already installed.

rollback.explain: Remove packages that were installed from the list if you made a mistake.

placeholders.name: PACKAGE_NAME
placeholders.description: Name of the package to remove

warnings: Ensure the list does not contain foreign packages (like AUR) unless you have configured pacman to handle them, otherwise the command may fail or skip them.
